summary: Implemented `in` membership for Namespace and ClosedNamespace in rdflib/namespace.py. Namespace.__contains__ uses a prefix test (ref.startswith(self)). ClosedNamespace.__contains__ uses node-type-aware equality against stored term URIs, inherited by _RDFNamespace. The IPython completion hook now returns dir(self.uri). Added tests in test/test_namespace.py covering prefix positive/negative/self cases, SH, RDFS closed positive/negative plus plain-string and Literal negatives, RDF closed positive, and the _1 container-property negative. Tests were not run, per instructions. Nothing committed.
